SELECT count(*)::int AS "TotalAssets", COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(t."ConstructionCost", 0.0)), 0.0) AS "TotalConstructionCost", COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(t."AcquisitionCost", 0.0)), 0.0) AS "TotalAcquisitionCost", COALESCE(sum(COALESCE(t."RenovationCost", 0.0)), 0.0) AS "TotalRenovationCost"
FROM (
    SELECT a."AcquisitionCost", a."ConstructionCost", a."RenovationCost", 1 AS "Key"
    FROM "Assets" AS a
) AS t
GROUP BY t."Key"
LIMIT 1

    SELECT COALESCE(a."Condition", 'unknown') AS "Key"
